name: research_experiment
description: Experiment-run failures typed so the lab notebook structures itself.

verdicts.note: the run wants more memory than exists

remedy.note: calibratable in shape (smaller batch, gradient accumulation); manual until verified

verdicts.note: the input, not the method, failed

remedy.note: usually learning rate / init; a config sweep is the verification

verdicts.note: the effect is smaller than the noise

remedy.note: more seeds/samples is the honest remedy; a bigger claim is not
